speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Ten at a table, and a cold pie. Sit, if your back will allow a bench in your own house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It will allow the pie. The bench and I are in talks.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: For the Christmas pack I want a ballad. With a murder in it. A good one, not a sermon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A ballad with a murder is a murder with a tune. I'll see what the stalls have, and I won't promise the corpse.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I don't want a ballad. I want your answer on too quick, written, so I can keep it when you've made it prettier.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is not prettier. You said she is too quick to say yes, and you were right, and I have not mended her.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Then write that. Not the line where she says it herself. The other thing. That saying it doesn't mend it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll write it. Not tonight. Tonight the pack is a horn, a shirt, and your grandmother's jar.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Is a player's sword sharp?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No sharper than the lath one, and a deal heavier. You'd feel it in the wrist before you felt it anywhere else.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Then what is the good of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It looks like the thing, at forty paces, and it does not cut the boy who is too near. That is the whole good.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: I could carry a blunt one as far as the bridge. Further, if you let me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Finish school.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: You did not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And look at me, walking home at thirty-one.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: That is a living. You said so.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing is arranged for you in London. Nobody's admiring a play is a living, and I will not pretend I have a place to put you.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Take the back to London, brother, and leave the rest of you here. We've had the rest all month, and it argues.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: To my son's lord, whoever keeps his chamber. A player! Well. He's put twenty shillings in a neighbour's barn and his spine after it, and I never did so much when I was bailiff.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty shillings and a spine. I'll take the toast, Father, and I won't improve it.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: And the ballad.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: And the sword stays heavier than mine. I heard you.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: And the sentence, written, when you are not at a table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the ballad, if London has a murder it can spare. Susanna, the sentence is yours, and it will come written. Edmund, the cues are yours, and the shop is yours. I am the one on the horse.
